description.raw: '''Active:''' '''Akali''' restores [[File:Energy icon.svg|15px|link=Energy]] 100 energy over 0.4 seconds and gains [[File:Movement speed icon.png|15px|link=Movement speed]] '''bonus''' movement speed that decays over 2 seconds. She also detonates a smoke bomb a fixed distance away in the target direction, creating a circular shroud that expands over the next 5 seconds into a ring. The shroud does not permeate terrain, and will expand toward nearby enemy champions. While the shroud is active, '''Akali's''' '''maximum''' energy is increased by 100.
description.text: Active: Akali restores  100 energy over 0.4 seconds and gains  bonus movement speed that decays over 2 seconds. She also detonates a smoke bomb a fixed distance away in the target direction, creating a circular shroud that expands over the next 5 seconds into a ring. The shroud does not permeate terrain, and will expand toward nearby enemy champions. While the shroud is active, Akali's maximum energy is increased by 100.

description2.raw: Entering the shroud renders '''Akali''' [[File:Twilight Shroud old2.png|20px|link=Stealth#Invisibility|An icon representing the keyword Invisibility]] [[:Stealth#Invisibility|invisible]], unless she is [[File:Dash.png|20px|link=Dash|An icon representing the keyword Dash]] [[:Dash|dashing]].
description2.text: Entering the shroud renders Akali invisible, unless she is dashing.

description3.raw: Declaring a basic attack or casting an ability will break the invisibility and prevent '''Akali''' from entering it again for 1 – 0.625 (based on level) seconds, refreshing on subsequent attacks and casts.
description3.text: Declaring a basic attack or casting an ability will break the invisibility and prevent Akali from entering it again for 1 – 0.625 (based on level) seconds, refreshing on subsequent attacks and casts.

description4.raw: ''The [[File:Akali Shuriken Flip.png|20xpx|border|link=Akali#Shuriken Flip|An icon for Akali's ability Shuriken Flip]] [[Akali#Shuriken Flip|marked]] section of Twilight Shroud will linger for the mark's duration, even after the shroud ends.''
description4.text: The marked section of Twilight Shroud will linger for the mark's duration, even after the shroud ends.

description5.raw: '''''Akali''' can move during Twilight Shroud's cast time.''
description5.text: Akali can move during Twilight Shroud's cast time.

notes.raw: * '''Akali''' will also not gain the [[File:Twilight Shroud old2.png|20px|link=Stealth#Invisibility|An icon representing the keyword Invisibility]] [[:Stealth#Invisibility|invisibility]] if she is [[File:Recall.png|20xpx|border|link=Recall|An icon representing Recall]] [[Recall|Recalling]]. * It is possible for '''Akali''' to detonate the smoke bomb on the far side of terrain from her current location. * ''Twilight Shroud's'' effects begin at the start of the cast time. * Using a basic attack breaks the stealth at the start of the attack windup.
notes.text:
Akali will also not gain the invisibility if she is Recalling.
It is possible for Akali to detonate the smoke bomb on the far side of terrain from her current location.
Twilight Shroud's effects begin at the start of the cast time.
Using a basic attack breaks the stealth at the start of the attack windup.
